test_cases.summary:
Verify system assigns next sequential version number for new JSON version
when a session exists with version history already available
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version Tracker – Auto Sequential Version Number

Scenario: Verify system assigns next sequential version number for new JSON version

Given a session exists with version history already available
When the user creates/downloads a new JSON version
Then the system should automatically assign the next sequential version number
test_cases.acceptance:
The system should automatically assign the next sequential version number
The behavior should be validated when the user creates/downloads a new JSON version.

test_cases.summary:
Verify system does not create duplicate version numbers
when multiple versions already exist in version history
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version Tracker – No Duplicate Version Numbers

Scenario: Verify system does not create duplicate version numbers

Given multiple versions already exist in version history
When the user creates a new JSON version repeatedly
Then each new version should have a unique sequential number without duplicates
test_cases.acceptance:
Each new version should have a unique sequential number without duplicates
The behavior should be validated when the user creates a new JSON version repeatedly.

test_cases.summary:
Verify assigned version number is displayed in Version History list
when a new JSON version is created successfully
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version Tracker – Version Number Visible in History

Scenario: Verify assigned version number is displayed in Version History list

Given a new JSON version is created successfully
When the user opens the Version History list
Then the assigned version number should be displayed clearly for that entry
test_cases.acceptance:
The assigned version number should be displayed clearly for that entry
The behavior should be validated when the user opens the Version History list.

test_cases.summary:
Verify version numbers follow correct increment order
when the latest version is V3
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version Tracker – Sequential Increment Pattern

Scenario: Verify version numbers follow correct increment order

Given the latest version is V3
When the user creates a new JSON version
Then the new version number should be V4
test_cases.acceptance:
The new version number should be V4
The behavior should be validated when the user creates a new JSON version.

test_cases.summary:
Verify assigned version number persists after refresh/relogin
when a new version was created successfully with a sequential number
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version Tracker – Persist Version Number Correctly

Scenario: Verify assigned version number persists after refresh/relogin

Given a new version was created successfully with a sequential number
When the user refreshes the page or logs out and logs in again
Then the same version number should remain stored and visible in Version History
test_cases.acceptance:
The same version number should remain stored and visible in Version History
The behavior should be validated when the user refreshes the page or logs out and logs in again.

test_cases.summary:
Verify version numbering is session-specific and sequential
when two different sessions exist with their own version history
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version Tracker – Sequential Numbering Across Multiple Sessions

Scenario: Verify version numbering is session-specific and sequential

Given two different sessions exist with their own version history
When the user creates versions in both sessions
Then each session should maintain independent sequential numbering without conflict
test_cases.acceptance:
Each session should maintain independent sequential numbering without conflict
The behavior should be validated when the user creates versions in both sessions.

test_cases.summary:
Verify version numbers remain unique when two versions created simultaneously
when two users attempt to create a JSON version at the same time for the same session
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version Tracker – Concurrency Handling

Scenario: Verify version numbers remain unique when two versions created simultaneously

Given two users attempt to create a JSON version at the same time for the same session
When both submit version creation concurrently
Then the system should assign unique sequential version numbers without duplicates or conflicts
test_cases.acceptance:
The system should assign unique sequential version numbers without duplicates or conflicts
The behavior should be validated when both submit version creation concurrently.

test_cases.summary:
Verify each generated JSON is stored as a new immutable version
when version history already contains existing versions
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version Tracker – New Version Stored as Separate Entry

Scenario: Verify each generated JSON is stored as a new immutable version

Given version history already contains existing versions
When the user generates a new JSON version
Then the system should store it as a new entry
And should not overwrite any existing version
test_cases.acceptance:
The system should store it as a new entry
The behavior should be validated when the user generates a new JSON version.

test_cases.summary:
Verify earlier versions remain unchanged after new version creation
when V1 and V2 exist in version history
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version Tracker – Previous Versions Remain Unchanged

Scenario: Verify earlier versions remain unchanged after new version creation

Given V1 and V2 exist in version history
When the user generates V3
Then V1 and V2 JSON content should remain unchanged
test_cases.acceptance:
V1 and V2 JSON content should remain unchanged
The behavior should be validated when the user generates V3.

test_cases.summary:
Verify system does not provide option to overwrite an existing version
when the user is viewing the Version History list
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version Tracker – No Replace/Overwrite Option in UI

Scenario: Verify system does not provide option to overwrite an existing version

Given the user is viewing the Version History list
When the user checks available actions for each version
Then overwrite/replace option should not be available
test_cases.acceptance:
Overwrite/replace option should not be available
The behavior should be validated when the user checks available actions for each version.

test_cases.summary:
Verify system does not allow deleting a version entry
when the user is viewing Version History list
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version Tracker – No Delete Option in UI

Scenario: Verify system does not allow deleting a version entry

Given the user is viewing Version History list
When the user checks action buttons for a version entry
Then Delete option should not be available
test_cases.acceptance:
Delete option should not be available
The behavior should be validated when the user checks action buttons for a version entry.

test_cases.summary:
Verify version history persists after refresh/relogin
when multiple versions exist in Version History list
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version Tracker – Version History Always Retained

Scenario: Verify version history persists after refresh/relogin

Given multiple versions exist in Version History list
When the user refreshes the page or logs out and logs in again
Then all previously created versions should remain visible and unchanged
test_cases.acceptance:
All previously created versions should remain visible and unchanged
The behavior should be validated when the user refreshes the page or logs out and logs in again.

test_cases.summary:
Verify system maintains full history even after many versions created
when 20+ versions exist for a session
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version Tracker – Storage Integrity After Multiple Versions

Scenario: Verify system maintains full history even after many versions created

Given 20+ versions exist for a session
When the user creates another new version
Then all versions should remain stored permanently without loss or corruption
test_cases.acceptance:
All versions should remain stored permanently without loss or corruption
The behavior should be validated when the user creates another new version.

test_cases.summary:
Verify backend blocks deletion attempt for a version record
when the system does not allow deleting versions
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version Tracker – Attempt Delete via Direct Request Blocked

Scenario: Verify backend blocks deletion attempt for a version record

Given the system does not allow deleting versions
When the user attempts to delete a version via API call or forced request
Then the backend should reject the request
And return access denied / operation not permitted response
test_cases.acceptance:
The backend should reject the request
The behavior should be validated when the user attempts to delete a version via API call or forced request.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Download action is available for each version entry
when version history contains JSON versions
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version Download – Download Button Visibility

Scenario: Verify Download action is available for each version entry

Given version history contains JSON versions
When the user opens Version History list
Then Download action/button should be visible for each version entry
test_cases.acceptance:
Download action/button should be visible for each version entry
The behavior should be validated when the user opens Version History list.

test_cases.summary:
Verify download starts when user selects a version and clicks Download
when the user is authorized to download session versions
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version Download – Initiate Download Successfully

Scenario: Verify download starts when user selects a version and clicks Download

Given the user is authorized to download session versions
When the user selects a version entry
And clicks Download
Then the system should initiate JSON file download automatically
test_cases.acceptance:
The system should initiate JSON file download automatically
The behavior should be validated when the user selects a version entry.

test_cases.summary:
Verify the selected version artifact is downloaded correctly
when multiple versions exist in history (V1, V2, V3)
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version Download – Correct Version Downloaded

Scenario: Verify the selected version artifact is downloaded correctly

Given multiple versions exist in history (V1, V2, V3)
When the user downloads V2
Then the downloaded JSON file should match V2 content stored in system
test_cases.acceptance:
The downloaded JSON file should match V2 content stored in system
The behavior should be validated when the user downloads V2.

test_cases.summary:
Verify system validates authorization before download
when the user does not have permission to download versions
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version Download – Authorization Validation

Scenario: Verify system validates authorization before download

Given the user does not have permission to download versions
When the user clicks Download for a version entry
Then the system should block download
And show user-friendly authorization failure message
test_cases.acceptance:
The system should block download
The behavior should be validated when the user clicks Download for a version entry.

test_cases.summary:
Verify backend blocks direct download request without permission
when the user is unauthorized
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version Download – Backend Blocks Unauthorized API Download

Scenario: Verify backend blocks direct download request without permission

Given the user is unauthorized
When the user attempts to download version artifact via direct API call
Then backend should reject request
And return access denied response
test_cases.acceptance:
Backend should reject request
The behavior should be validated when the user attempts to download version artifact via direct API call.

test_cases.summary:
Verify user-friendly message shown when file cannot be retrieved
when a version exists in UI but file is missing/corrupted in storage
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version Download – File Retrieval Failure Handling

Scenario: Verify user-friendly message shown when file cannot be retrieved

Given a version exists in UI but file is missing/corrupted in storage
When the user clicks Download
Then the system should show a user-friendly message
And download should not start
test_cases.acceptance:
The system should show a user-friendly message
The behavior should be validated when the user clicks Download.

test_cases.summary:
Verify download streams directly without navigating away
when the user is on Version History list
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version Download – Secure Streaming (No Full Page Reload)

Scenario: Verify download streams directly without navigating away

Given the user is on Version History list
When the user clicks Download
Then the file should download directly
And the user should remain on the same page
test_cases.acceptance:
The file should download directly
The behavior should be validated when the user clicks Download.

test_cases.summary:
Verify downloaded file is valid JSON format
when the user downloads a JSON version artifact
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version Download – Download File Format Validation

Scenario: Verify downloaded file is valid JSON format

Given the user downloads a JSON version artifact
When the file is opened in editor
Then the content should be valid JSON and not corrupted
test_cases.acceptance:
The content should be valid JSON and not corrupted
The behavior should be validated when the file is opened in editor.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Download button is disabled when no version is selected
when the user opens the Version History list
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version Download – Download Disabled by Default

Scenario: Verify Download button is disabled when no version is selected

Given the user opens the Version History list
When no version row is selected
Then the Download button should remain disabled or inactive
test_cases.acceptance:
The Download button should remain disabled or inactive
The behavior should be validated when no version row is selected.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Download button becomes enabled after selecting a version row
when the Version History list is displayed
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version Download – Enable Download After Selection

Scenario: Verify Download button becomes enabled after selecting a version row

Given the Version History list is displayed
When the user selects a valid version row (ex: V2)
Then the Download button should become enabled/active
test_cases.acceptance:
The Download button should become enabled/active
The behavior should be validated when the user selects a valid version row (ex: V2).

test_cases.summary:
Verify selected version identifier is validated before download
when a version row is selected
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version Download – Correct Version Identifier Used

Scenario: Verify selected version identifier is validated before download

Given a version row is selected
When the user clicks Download
Then the system should validate the selected version identifier
And start download only for the selected version
test_cases.acceptance:
The system should validate the selected version identifier
The behavior should be validated when the user clicks Download.

test_cases.summary:
Verify changing selection updates which version is downloaded
when the user selected version V2 and Download is enabled
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version Download – Change Selection Updates Download Target

Scenario: Verify changing selection updates which version is downloaded

Given the user selected version V2 and Download is enabled
When the user changes selection to V4
And clicks Download
Then the system should download V4 (not V2)
test_cases.acceptance:
The system should download V4 (not V2)
The behavior should be validated when the user changes selection to V4.

test_cases.summary:
Verify system blocks download if selected row is invalid
when the user selected a version row
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version Download – Prevent Download With Invalid Selection

Scenario: Verify system blocks download if selected row is invalid

Given the user selected a version row
When the selected version identifier is missing/invalid due to UI glitch
Then the system should block download
And show a user-friendly message
test_cases.acceptance:
The system should block download
The behavior should be validated when the selected version identifier is missing/invalid due to UI glitch.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Download becomes disabled if selection is cleared
when a version row is selected and Download is enabled
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version Download – Disabled Again After Deselection

Scenario: Verify Download becomes disabled if selection is cleared

Given a version row is selected and Download is enabled
When the user clears the selection (click outside / deselect row)
Then the Download button should return to disabled/inactive state
test_cases.acceptance:
The Download button should return to disabled/inactive state
The behavior should be validated when the user clears the selection (click outside / deselect row).

test_cases.summary:
Verify version rows support single selection only
when the user opens Version History list
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version Selection – Single Selection UI Control

Scenario: Verify version rows support single selection only

Given the user opens Version History list
When the list is displayed
Then the system should allow selecting only one version row at a time
test_cases.acceptance:
The system should allow selecting only one version row at a time
The behavior should be validated when the list is displayed.

test_cases.summary:
Verify selection indicator is visible for selected row
when Version History list is displayed
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version Selection – Row Highlight / Radio Visible

Scenario: Verify selection indicator is visible for selected row

Given Version History list is displayed
When the user selects a version row
Then the selected row should be highlighted or radio button should show selected state
test_cases.acceptance:
The selected row should be highlighted or radio button should show selected state
The behavior should be validated when the user selects a version row.

test_cases.summary:
Verify previous selection is removed when new version selected
when the user selected version V1
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version Selection – Selecting New Row Deselects Previous

Scenario: Verify previous selection is removed when new version selected

Given the user selected version V1
When the user selects version V3
Then V1 should be deselected automatically
And only V3 should remain selected
test_cases.acceptance:
V1 should be deselected automatically
The behavior should be validated when the user selects version V3.

test_cases.summary:
Verify UI stores only one selected version identifier
when a version is selected in Version History list
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version Selection – Only One Identifier Stored

Scenario: Verify UI stores only one selected version identifier

Given a version is selected in Version History list
When the user selects another version row
Then the system should update selection state with only one active version identifier
test_cases.acceptance:
The system should update selection state with only one active version identifier
The behavior should be validated when the user selects another version row.

test_cases.summary:
Verify user cannot multi-select versions using keyboard shortcuts
when the Version History list is displayed
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version Selection – Prevent Multi Select Using Keyboard

Scenario: Verify user cannot multi-select versions using keyboard shortcuts

Given the Version History list is displayed
When the user attempts multi-select using Ctrl+Click or Shift+Click
Then the system should still allow only one version selection at a time
test_cases.acceptance:
The system should still allow only one version selection at a time
The behavior should be validated when the user attempts multi-select using Ctrl+Click or Shift+Click.

test_cases.summary:
Verify selection can be cleared safely (if supported)
when a version row is selected
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version Selection – Selection Clears Properly

Scenario: Verify selection can be cleared safely (if supported)

Given a version row is selected
When the user clicks outside the table (or uses clear action if available)
Then the selection should be cleared safely
And no multiple selection should occur
test_cases.acceptance:
The selection should be cleared safely
The behavior should be validated when the user clicks outside the table (or uses clear action if available).

test_cases.summary:
Verify metadata fields are displayed in Version History table
when version history contains JSON versions
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version Metadata – Metadata Columns Visible

Scenario: Verify metadata fields are displayed in Version History table

Given version history contains JSON versions
When the user opens Version History list
Then Version Number, Created Date & Time, and Generated User details should be displayed
test_cases.acceptance:
Version Number, Created Date & Time, and Generated User details should be displayed
The behavior should be validated when the user opens Version History list.

test_cases.summary:
Verify displayed version number matches stored value
when a version exists in history with stored version number V5
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version Metadata – Version Number Accuracy

Scenario: Verify displayed version number matches stored value

Given a version exists in history with stored version number V5
When the Version History list is displayed
Then the UI should display version number exactly as stored (V5)
test_cases.acceptance:
The UI should display version number exactly as stored (V5)
The behavior should be validated when the Version History list is displayed.

test_cases.summary:
Verify creation date and time match stored value
when a version entry exists with stored timestamp
test_cases.description:
Feature: Version Metadata – Created Date & Time Accuracy

Scenario: Verify creation date and time match stored value

Given a version entry exists with stored timestamp
When the Version History list is displayed
Then the Created Date & Time should match the stored timestamp without alteration
test_cases.acceptance:
The Created Date & Time should match the stored timestamp without alteration
The behavior should be validated when the Version History list is displayed.
